name: Dahgee
description: Dahgee was a planet where unique lightsaber crystals were mined. A small group of Jedi with unique robes also lived there. The lightsaber crystals on Dahgee gave their lightsabers a strange, zigzagging blade with a black core, almost like a tree branch.
